Washington, D. C. 20240
38
Dear Mr. Watt:
Thank you for sending us advance copies of the <u>Proposed</u>

Departmental Implementation of Executive Order 11644 Pertaining

to Use of Off-road Vehicles on the <u>Public Lands</u>. Our staff has
reviewed the statement and found it to be a comprehensive and
well-documented study of a rather complicated and delicate
situation.
We totally concur with your statement on page 26 that a decision to take no action, thereby maintaining the status quo, is alternatively rife with problems.
Florida, too, has recognized the need to resolve the conflict between outdoor recreation vehicles and the more passive recreationists. In this pursuit, we have formed an inter-agency study team with the goal of formulating workable solutions to the conflict. Hopefully, their recommendations will be ready for implementation by the Fall.
In addition to our comments, you should be receiving those of several other state agencies, all embodied within the response of the state clearinghouse. By utilizing the clearinghouse your statement will receive maximum coverage and I am confident that other agencies will provide several meaningful comments.
Sincerely,
Ney C. Landrum
Director
Division of Recreation and Parks
